text:
The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across. It holds two corn cob pieces, each about 4-5 cm across and 3-4 cm long, plus a small spinach salad with a couple of cherry tomatoes and some shredded carrot.

Corn pieces: each is about 60-70 g, and corn runs about 0.9 kcal/g on the cob when you count only the edible part. Two pieces come to about 130 g, or roughly 110 kcal.

Salad: about 30 g of spinach, 2 cherry tomatoes at about 30 g, and a little carrot. That is about 65 g and 20 kcal. There is no visible dressing.

Total: about 195 g and 130 kcal.
